#### Syllabus and Class Notes

| Unit              | Syllabus                         |       Vibha's Notes                |
| :---------------- | -------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| Unit 1            |  - Introduction <br> - Boolean Functions <br> - Truth tables <br> - Boolean Algebra <br> - Identities <br> - Logic minimization <br> - K- Maps <br> - Adder/Subtractor, Overflow  | [DDCO Unit 1.pdf](DDCO%20Unit%201.pdf) |
| Unit 2            | - Muxes, Decoders, Shifters <br> - Gate/Wire delays, Timing <br> - Latches, Flip-flops <br> - Synchronous logic design <br> - Finite State Machines| [DDCO Unit 2.pdf](DDCO%20Unit%202.pdf) |
| Unit 3            | - FSM examples <br> - Counters, Memory array <br> - Carry-lookahead and Prefix adders | [DDCO Unit 3.pdf](DDCO%20Unit%203.pdf) |
| Unit 4            | - Shift/add multiplier/divider <br> - Wallace tree multiplier <br> - Floating point <br> - Assembly Language, Machine Language | [DDCO Unit 4.pdf](DDCO%20Unit%204.pdf) |
| Unit 5            | - Addressing Modes <br> - Performance analysis <br> - Single-cycle, Multi-cycle processor datapath and control <br> - Systolic array matrix multiply <br> - Overview of computer systems organization | [DDCO Unit 5.pdf](DDCO%20Unit%205.pdf) |


<br>


#### Textbooks: 

-  **T1**: "Digital Design and Computer Architecture", David Money Harris, Sarah L Harris, 2nd Edition, Morgan Kaufmann, 2012


<br>

#### Reference Books:

- **R1**: "Digital Design", M Morris Mano, Michael D Ciletti, 6th Edition, Pearson, 2018
- **R2**: "Computer Organization and Design", David A Patterson, John L Hennessey, 5th Edition, Elsevier, 2016
- **R3**: "Computer Organization and Design", Carl Hamacher, Safwat Zaky, Zvonko Vranesic, 5th Edition, Tata McGraw-Hill, 2011
